app_fee.value: FU Berlin is a public university that does not charge application fees for doctoral admission.
app_fee.quote: There are some fees and required contributions of approximately €313 per semester.

fee_waiver.quote: There are some fees and required contributions of approximately €313 per semester.

gre_general.value: GRE General is not required for doctoral admission.
gre_general.quote: Sufficient English language skills corresponding to level B2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR)

toefl_min.value: The central FU doctoral pages set no TOEFL minimum. English rules are set by each department's regulations.

ielts_min.value: The central FU doctoral pages set no IELTS minimum. English rules are set by each department's regulations.

english_waiver.value: No central FU rule on English for Indian applicants was found. Departments differ: some ask for English proof only when the thesis is in English.

also.quote: Sufficient English language skills corresponding to level B2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR)

notes: Admission rules are set by each department's doctoral regulations, saved on the program records. Central pages fetched: DRS admission (https://www.fu-berlin.de/en/sites/drs/doctorate/admission/index.html), enrolment (https://www.fu-berlin.de/en/studium/bewerbung/immatrikulation/promotion/index.html), deadlines (https://www.fu-berlin.de/en/studium/bewerbung/bewerbungsfristen/index.html, undergraduate only), Natural Sciences doctoral programme (https://www.fu-berlin.de/sites/naturalsciences/application/index.html; no funding). Guessed URL https://www.fu-berlin.de/en/sites/graduate-school/ returned 404 (not a block). The programme list used is the archived DRS page https://www.fu-berlin.de/en/sites/drs/z_archiv_drs_en/drs_programs/natural_and_life/index.html; no PhD route found for astronomy, statistics, datasci, materials, neuro, biomed or the engineering fields in the pages fetched. Only the 2013 English translation of the physics regulations was fetched (superseded; the 2023 amendment in German was not fetched).
